profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Lazada Group
profile.summary:
Experienced Senior Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the internet industry. Skilled in Java, Go (Golang), PHP, MySQL, Linux...
Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's Degree focused in Computer Software Engineering from the Hutech University.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam · On-site
positions.description:
- Pivotal Tech Stack Migration: Led a significant technology shift from PHP/Go to Java following Alibaba's acquisition and subsequent re-platforming of the Lazada system, ensuring continuity and scalability.

- High-Impact E-commerce Feature Development: Engineered the backend for the Lazada Loyalty application, a core feature driving customer retention and engagement on a major e-commerce platform.

- Core Logistics System Expertise: Transitioned to the Lazada Logistics team, focusing initially on the Fleet Management domain (courier and related operations management).

- Integrated Workforce Management: Expanded scope to include the Workforce Management domain, successfully merging systems to oversee and optimize all personnel within Lazada Logistics facilities.

positions.title: Senior GO/PHP Developer
positions.locationName: 20th Floor - Saigon Centre 2, 67 Le Loi, District 1, HCMC, Vietnam
positions.description:
Accomplished software developer with a proven track record of scaling high-traffic e-commerce platforms. Key accomplishments include:

- Platform Modernization: Join the team to upgrade the legacy platform to a modern PHP technology stack, improving maintainability and development velocity.

- Performance Optimization: As part of the Core Platform Team, identified and resolved bottlenecks to enhance overall system stability and user experience.

- Microservices Migration: Spearheaded the architectural shift toward high-performance microservices by designing and implementing critical components using GO, significantly reducing latency for high-volume transactions.

positions.title: Senior PHP Developer
positions.locationName: 10th Floor, Hai Au Building, 39B Truong Son, Ward 4, Tan Binh Dist, HCMC. · On-site
positions.description:
About the Company

Axon Active is a Swiss-based offshore software development company with a strong presence in Vietnam. The firm provides high-end agile software engineering services, specializing in building complex enterprise solutions and mobile applications for international clients.

Professional Summary

Served as the Principal Developer for InfoCube, a premiere Swiss business intelligence platform that provides high-quality, up-to-date business information to help companies mitigate financial risks and identify new sales opportunities. My role encompassed both the maintenance of the core web platform and the end-to-end development of the mobile ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements:

Web Platform Leadership: Acted as the principal developer for the web-based InfoCube application, ensuring the reliability and performance of a critical database used for Swiss business decision-making.

Backend & Search Optimization: Maintained and enhanced the platform’s core architecture using PHP, while optimizing data retrieval and search functionality through Solr and MySQL.

iOS Development (Greenfield Project): Spearheaded the mobile strategy by developing the InfoCube iOS application from scratch, handling the entire development lifecycle from initial architecture to final deployment.

Data Integrity & Performance: Managed large-scale business datasets to ensure users had access to reliable, real-time information for avoiding payment defaults and analyzing market trends.

Agile Collaboration: Worked within a high-performing team to deliver Swiss-quality software standards in a dynamic development environment.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam · On-site
positions.description:
D2D3 S.A. is a Belgium-based consulting and engineering firm specializing in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and territorial development. The company focuses on providing innovative spatial data solutions and strategic decision-support tools for urban planning and environmental management.

As the sole developer for the firm’s web mapping initiatives, I was responsible for the end-to-end design, development, and deployment of a comprehensive web-based GIS platform. I transitioned complex geographical data into interactive, user-facing applications to support the company’s engineering projects.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements:

Full-Stack GIS Development: Architected and developed a custom web mapping application using Mapbuilder, ensuring a responsive and intuitive user interface for spatial data visualization.

Spatial Data Management: Managed and optimized large-scale geographic datasets using GeoServer to provide high-performance WMS/WFS services.

Database Engineering: Designed and maintained a robust PostgreSQL backend, utilizing PostGIS for efficient spatial query processing and data integrity.

System Integration: Collaborated closely with academic and industry experts to translate technical territorial requirements into functional software features.

Autonomous Project Ownership: Led the entire software development lifecycle, from initial requirement gathering to final production support and system maintenance.
